chunks: “Whoever is afflicted with a calamity, whether he grieves intensely over it or does not grieve, whether he is patient through it or is not patient, his reward from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is Paradise.”

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One who grants reward
key_terms.جَزِعَ: he became intensely distressed or grief-stricken
key_terms.مُصِيبَةٍ: a calamity or affliction that befalls a person

ai.seo_question: What reward does Allah give for being afflicted by calamity according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a believer is afflicted by a calamity, the ultimate reward prepared by Allah عزّ وجلّ is Paradise. It highlights the immense divine recompense connected to enduring affliction and directs attention to the afterlife outcome of worldly trials.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.517 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever is afflicted with a calamity, whether they express intense grief over it or not, whether they exercise patience or not, their reward from Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious, is Paradise."
